description: Hand-labelled cases for the phase 4.5 agent: requirement matching against CVs, recipe reading and follow-up intent detection. Fictional people and content. The rules were written alongside many of these cases, so this is NOT a held-out test: it measures the rules on this set and says nothing about unseen CVs. The point of the set is the error TYPES: a requirement must never come out VERIFIED_MATCH unless the CV really says it (false verified = 0).
